None,\n            created_at: Utc::now(),\n            created_by: None,\n            updated_at: Utc::now(),\n            closed_at: None,\n            close_reason: None,\n            closed_by_session: None,\n            due_at: None,\n            defer_until: None,\n            external_ref: None,\n            source_system: None,\n            source_repo: None,\n            deleted_at: None,\n            deleted_by: None,\n            delete_reason: None,\n            original_type: None,\n            compaction_level: None,\n            compacted_at: None,\n            compacted_at_commit: None,\n            original_size: None,\n            sender: None,\n            ephemeral: false,\n            pinned: false,\n            is_template: false,\n            labels: Vec::new(),\n            dependencies: Vec::new(),\n            comments: Vec::new(),\n            annotations: BTreeMap::new(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Issue {\n    pub fn new(id: String, title: String, source_repo: String) -> Self {\n        let now = Utc::now();\n        Issue {\n            id,\n            title,\n            source_repo: Some(source_repo),\n            created_at: now,\n            updated_at: now,\n            status: Status::default(),\n            priority: Priority::default(),\n            issue_type: IssueType::default(),\n            ..Default::default()\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn is_blocked(&self) -> bool {\n        self.dependencies\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|d| matches!(d.dep_type, DependencyType::Blocks))\n            .any(|d| {\n                self.source_repo\n                    .as_ref()\n                    .map(|repo| repo == &d.depends_on_id)\n                    .unwrap_or(false)\n            })\n    }\n\n    pub fn content_hash(&self) -> String {\n        use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};\n        let serialized = serde_json::to_string(self).unwrap_or_default();\n        let hash = Sha256::digest(serialized.as_bytes());\n        format!(\"{:x}\", hash)\n    }\n\n    /// Compare two issues using sync semantics instead of raw struct equality.\n    ///\n    /// This ignores derived or volatile audit fields that would otherwise make\n    /// semantically identical issues look different across import/export\n    /// boundaries, while still comparing the full synced payload including\n    /// labels, dependencies, comments, and user-visible timestamps like `due_at`.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn sync_equals(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {\n        if self.id != other.id\n            || self.title != other.title\n            || self.description != other.description\n            || self.design != other.design\n            || self.acceptance_criteria != other.acceptance_criteria\n            || self.notes != other.notes\n            || self.status != other.status\n            || self.priority != other.priority\n            || self.issue_type != other.issue_type\n            || self.assignee != other.assignee\n            || self.owner != other.owner\n            || self.estimated_minutes != other.estimated_minutes\n            || self.created_by != other.created_by\n            || self.closed_at != other.closed_at\n            || self.close_reason != other.close_reason\n            || self.closed_by_session != other.closed_by_session\n            || self.due_at != other.due_at\n            || self.defer_until != other.defer_until\n            || self.external_ref != other.external_ref\n            || self.source_system != other.source_system\n            || self.source_repo != other.source_repo\n            || self.deleted_at != other.deleted_at\n            || self.deleted_by != other.deleted_by\n            || self.delete_reason != other.delete_reason\n            || self.original_type != other.original_type\n            || self.compacted_at != other.compacted_at\n            || self.compacted_at_commit != other.compacted_at_commit\n            || self.original_size != other.original_size\n            || self.sender != other.sender\n            || self.ephemeral != other.ephemeral\n            || self.pinned != other.pinned\n            || self.is_template != other.is_template\n        {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Handle compaction_level serialization quirk where None == 0\n        if self.compaction_level.unwrap_or(0) != other.compaction_level.unwrap_or(0) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Fast path for relations: if lengths differ, they can't be equal\n        if self.dependencies.len() != other.dependencies.len()\n            || self.comments.len() != other.comments.len()\n        {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Compare labels (order independent)\n        let mut self_labels = self.labels.clone();\n        self_labels.sort_unstable();\n        self_labels.dedup();\n        let mut other_labels = other.labels.clone();\n        other_labels.sort_unstable();\n        other_labels.dedup();\n        if self_labels != other_labels {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Compare dependencies (order independent)\n        let mut self_deps = self.dependencies.clone();\n        self_deps.sort_by(|left, right| {\n            left.issue_id\n                .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n                .then_with(|| left.depends_on_id.cmp(&right.depends_on_id))\n                .then_with(|| left.dep_type.as_str().cmp(right.dep_type.as_str()))\n                .then_with(|| left.created_at.cmp(&right.created_at))\n                .then_with(|| left.created_by.cmp(&right.created_by))\n                .then_with(|| left.metadata.cmp(&right.metadata))\n                .then_with(|| left.thread_id.cmp(&right.thread_id))\n        });\n        let mut other_deps = other.dependencies.clone();\n        other_deps.sort_by(|left, right| {\n            left.issue_id\n                .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n                .then_with(|| left.depends_on_id.cmp(&right.depends_on_id))\n                .then_with(|| left.dep_type.as_str().cmp(right.dep_type.as_str()))\n                .then_with(|| left.created_at.cmp(&right.created_at))\n                .then_with(|| left.created_by.cmp(&right.created_by))\n                .then_with(|| left.metadata.cmp(&right.metadata))\n                .then_with(|| left.thread_id.cmp(&right.thread_id))\n        });\n        if self_deps != other_deps {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Compare comments (order independent)\n        let mut self_comments = self.comments.clone();\n        self_comments.sort_by(|left, right| {\n            left.issue_id\n                .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n                .then_with(|| left.created_at.cmp(&right.created_at))\n                .then_with(|| left.author.cmp(&right.author))\n                .then_with(|| left.body.cmp(&right.body))\n                .then_with(|| left.id.cmp(&right.id))\n        });\n        let mut other_comments = other.comments.clone();\n        other_comments.sort_by(|left, right| {\n            left.issue_id\n                .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n                .then_with(|| left.created_at.cmp(&right.created_at))\n                .then_with(|| left.author.cmp(&right.author))\n                .then_with(|| left.body.cmp(&right.body))\n                .then_with(|| left.id.cmp(&right.id))\n        });\n        if self_comments != other_comments {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        true\n    }\n\n    /// Check if this issue is a tombstone that has exceeded its TTL.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn is_expired_tombstone(&self, retention_days: Option<u64>) -> bool {\n        if self.status != Status::Tombstone {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        let Some(days) = retention_days else {\n            return false;\n        };\n\n        if days == 0 {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        let Some(deleted_at) = self.deleted_at else {\n            return false;\n        };\n\n        // Clamp days to a safe maximum to avoid panic in Duration::days().\n        let max_safe_days = 365_u64 * 1000;\n        let days_i64 = i64::try_from(days.min(max_safe_days)).unwrap_or(365_000);\n        let expiration_time = deleted_at + chrono::Duration::days(days_i64);\n        Utc::now() > expiration_time\n    }\n}\n\n/// Epic completion status with child counts.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct EpicStatus {\n    pub epic: Issue,\n    pub total_children: usize,\n    pub closed_children: usize,\n    pub eligible_for_close: bool,\n}\n\n/// Relationship between two issues.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Dependency {\n    /// #[serde(rename = \"type\")]\n    pub dep_type: DependencyType,\n\n    /// Creation timestamp.\n    pub created_at: DateTime<Utc>,\n\n    /// Creator.\n    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if =    /// Thread ID for conversation linking.\n    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub thread_id: Option<String>,\n}\n\n/// A comment on an issue.\n#[derive(Debug, Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n887\t        self.load_dependencies(issue_id)\n888\t    }\n889\t\n890\t    /// Get dependency tree rooted at an issue using recursive CTE.\n891\t    ///\n892\t    /// # Arguments\n893\t    /// * `root_id` - The root issue ID\n894\t    /// * `direction` - \"down\" for what this depends on, \"up\" for what depends on this\n895\t    /// * `max_depth` - Maximum depth to traverse (0 = unlimited)\n896\t    ///\n897\t    /// # Returns\n898\t    /// Vector of tree nodes ordered by depth, suitable for tree display.\n899\t    pub fn get_dep_tree(\n900\t        &self,\n901\t        root_id: &str,\n902\t        direction: &str,\n903\t        max_depth: usize,\n904\t    ) -> Result<Vec<DepTreeNode>> {\n905\t        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n906\t\n907\t        // Build recursive CTE based on direction\n908\t        let (anchor_join, recursive_join, id_col, dep_col) = match direction {\n909\t            \"up\" => {\n910\t                // \"up\" means: find issues that depend on this one\n911\t                // Anchor: issues that directly depend on root\n912\t                // Recursive: issues that depend on those\n913\t                (\n914\t                    \"d.depends_on_id = ?1\",\n915\t                    \"d.depends_on_id = rec.id\",\n916\t                    \"d.issue_id\",\n917\t                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n918\t                )\n919\t            }\n920\t            _ => {\n921\t                // \"down\" (default): what this issue depends on\n922\t                // Anchor: issues that root directly depends on\n923\t                // Recursive: issues that those depend on\n924\t                (\n925\t                    \"d.issue_id = ?1\",\n926\t                    \"d.issue_id = rec.id\",\n927\t                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n928\t                    \"d.issue_id\",\n929\t                )\n930\t            }\n931\t        };\n932\t\n933\t        let depth_limit = if max_depth == 0 {\n934\t            String::new()\n935\t        } else {\n936\t            format!(\"AND rec.depth < {}\", max_depth)\n937\t        };\n938\t\n939\t        let sql = format!(\n940\t            \"WITH RECURSIVE dep_tree AS (\n941\t                -- Anchor: direct dependencies/dependents of root\n942\t                SELECT\n943\t                    {id_col} as id,\n944\t                    i.title,\n945\t                    i.status,\n946\t                    i.priority,\n947\t                    0 as depth,\n948\t                    d.type as dep_type,\n949\t                    '{root_id}' || ',' || {id_col} as path\n950\t                FROM dependencies d\n951\t                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n952\t                WHERE {anchor_join}\n953\t\n954\t                UNION ALL\n955\t\n956\t                -- Recursive: dependencies of dependencies\n957\t                SELECT\n958\t                    {id_col} as id,\n959\t                    i.title,\n960\t                    i.status,\n961\t                    i.priority,\n962\t                    rec.depth + 1 as depth,\n963\t                    d.type as dep_type,\n964\t                    rec.path || ',' || {id_col} as path\n965\t                FROM dependencies d\n966\t                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n967\t                INNER JOIN dep_tree rec ON {recursive_join}\n968\t                WHERE rec.path NOT LIKE '%' || {id_col} || '%'\n969\t                {depth_limit}\n970\t            )\n971\t            SELECT id, title, status, priority, depth, dep_type, path\n972\t            FROM dep_tree\n973\t            ORDER BY depth, id\"\n974\t        );\n975\t\n976\t        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n977\t        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![root_id])?;\n978\t        let mut nodes = Vec::new();\n979\t        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n980\t            let path: String = row.get(6)?;\n981\t            // Detect cycles: if the ID appears more than once in path, it's a cycle\n982\t            let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n983\t            let is_cycle = path.matches(&id).count() > 1;\n984\t\n985\t            nodes.push(DepTreeNode {\n986\t                id: row.get(0)?,\n987\t                title: row.get(1)?,\n988\t                status: row.get(2)?,\n989\t                priority: row.get(3)?,\n990\t                depth: row.get(4)?,\n991\t                dep_type: row.get::<_, Option<String>>(5)?,\n992\t                path: if is_cycle {\n993\t                    format!(\"{} [CYCLE]\", path)\n994\t                } else {\n995\t                    path\n996\t                },\n997\t            });\n998\t        }\n999\t        Ok(nodes)\n1000\t    }\n1001\t\n1002\t    pub fn get_dependents(&self, depends_on_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n1003\t        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n1004\t        let mut stmt =     Ok(result)\n1342\t    }\n1343\t\n1344\t    /// Get the score of the top candidate bead for claiming.\n1345\t    ///\n1346\t    /// Returns None if no candidates are available.\n1347\t    /// Used - LEFT JOINs velocity_stats on (issue_type, model, harness)\n1356\t    /// - Returns expected_seconds and combined_score for velocity-adjusted comparison\n1357\t    pub fn top_candidate_score(\n1358\t        &self,\n1359\t        model: Option<&str>,\n1360\t        harness: Option<&str>,\n1361\t    ) -> Result<Option<crate::claim::Score>> {\n1362\t        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n1363\t\n1364\t        if let (Some(m), Some(h)) = (model, harness) {\n1365\t            // Velocity-aware scoring: join velocity_stats and compute combined_score\n1366\t            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n1367\t                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n1368\t                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as                  downstream_impact DESC,\n1397\t                     critical_float ASC,\n1398\t                     i.priority ASC,\n1399\t                     i.created_at ASC\n1400\t )\n1751\t}\n1752\t\n1753\tfn parse_datetime(s: String) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n1754\t    let t = s.trim();\n1755\t    // bf's own format: RFC3339 (with timezone; optional fractional seconds).\n1756\t    match DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(t) {\n1757\t        Ok(dt) => Ok(dt.with_timezone(&Utc)),\n1758\t        Err(e) => {\n1759\t            // br / SQLite-native datetime() format: no timezone, space or 'T'\n1760\t            // separator (e.g. \"2026-05-15 21:10:36\"). Assume UTC. A workspace\n1761\t            // touched by both `br` and `bf` mixes these, and the RFC3339-only\n1762\t            // parser used to crash the entire list/flush (\"premature end of\n1763\t            // input\") on the first such row.\n1764\t            for fmt in [\n1765\t                \"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%.f\",\n1766\t                \"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%.f\",\n1767\t                \"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\",\n1768\t                \"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S\",\n1769\t            ] {\n1770\t                if let Ok(ndt) = NaiveDateTime::parse_from_str(t, fmt) {\n1771\t                    return Ok(ndt.and_utc());\n1772\t                }\n1773\t            }\n1774\t            Err(e.into())\n1775\t        }\n1776\t    }\n1777\t}\n1778\t\n1779\t#[cfg(test)]\n1780\tmod parse_datetime_tests {\n1781\t    use super::*;\n1782\t\n1783\t    #[test]\n1784\t    fn accepts_rfc3339_and_sqlite_native_formats() {\n1785\t        // RFC3339 with timezone (bf's own format)\n1786\t        assert!(parse_datetime(\"2026-05-15T20:00:00+00:00\".into()).is_ok());\n1787\t        // RFC3339 with nanosecond fraction\n1788\t        assert!(parse_datetime(\"2026-05-24T02:26:10.191834420+00:00\".into()).is_ok());\n1789\t        // br / SQLite-native: space separator, no timezone — previously crashed\n1790\t        // with compute_all_critical_paths(tx)?;\n\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn close_issue(&self, id: &str, reason: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            let now = Utc::now();\n            tx.execute(\n                \"UPDATE issues SET status = 'closed', closed_at = ?, close_reason = ?, updated_at = an issue using recursive CTE.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `root_id` - The root issue ID\n    /// * `direction` - \"down\" for what this depends on, \"up\" for what depends on this\n    /// * `max_depth` - Maximum depth to traverse (0 = unlimited)\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    /// Vector of tree nodes ordered by depth, suitable for tree display.\n    pub fn get_dep_tree(\n        &self,\n        root_id: &str,\n        direction: &str,\n        max_depth: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<DepTreeNode>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n\n        // Build recursive CTE based on direction\n        let (anchor_join, recursive_join, id_col, dep_col) = match direction {\n            \"up\" => {\n                // \"up\" means: find issues that depend on this one\n                // Anchor: issues that directly depend on root\n                // Recursive: issues that depend on those\n                (\n                    \"d.depends_on_id = ?1\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id = rec.id\",\n                    \"d.issue_id\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n                )\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // \"down\" (default): what this issue depends on\n                // Anchor: issues that root directly depends on\n                // Recursive: issues that those depend on\n                (\n                    \"d.issue_id = ?1\",\n                    \"d.issue_id = rec.id\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n                    \"d.issue_id\",\n                )\n            }\n        };\n\n        let depth_limit = if max_depth == 0 {\n            String::new()\n        } else {\n            format!(\"AND rec.depth < {}\", max_depth)\n        };\n\n        let sql = format!(\n            \"WITH RECURSIVE dep_tree AS (\n                -- Anchor: direct dependencies/dependents of root\n                SELECT\n                    {id_col} as id,\n                    i.title,\n                    i.status,\n                    i.priority,\n                    0 as depth,\n                    d.type as dep_type,\n                    '{root_id}' || ',' || {id_col} as path\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n                WHERE {anchor_join}\n\n                UNION ALL\n\n                -- Recursive: dependencies of dependencies\n                SELECT\n                    {id_col} as id,\n                    i.title,\n                    i.status,\n                    i.priority,\n                    rec.depth + 1 as depth,\n                    d.type as dep_type,\n                    rec.path || ',' || {id_col} as path\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n                INNER JOIN dep_tree rec ON {recursive_join}\n                WHERE rec.path NOT LIKE '%' || {id_col} || '%'\n                {depth_limit}\n            )\n            SELECT id, title, status, priority, depth, dep_type, path\n            FROM dep_tree\n            ORDER BY depth, id\"\n        );\n\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![root_id])?;\n        let mut nodes = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            let path: String = row.get(6)?;\n            // Detect cycles: if the ID appears more than once in path, it's a cycle\n            let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n            let is_cycle = path.matches(&id).count() > 1;\n\n            nodes.push(DepTreeNode {\n                id: row.get(0)?,\n                title: row.get(1)?,\n                status: row.get(2)?,\n                priority: row.get(3)?,\n                depth: row.get(4)?,\n                dep_type: row.get::<_, Option<String>>(5)?,\n                path: if is_cycle {\n                    format!(\"{} [CYCLE]\", path)\n                } else {\n                    path\n                },\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(nodes)\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_dependents(&self, depends_on_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut deps.push(Dependency {\n                issue_id: row.get(0)?,\n                depends_on_id: row.get(1)?,\n                dep_type: DependencyType::from_str(&type_str)\n                    .unwrap_or(DependencyType::Custom(type_str)),\n                metadata: row\n                    .get::<_, Option<String>>(3)?\n                    .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str(&s).ok()),\n                thread_id: row.get(4)?,\n                created_at: parse_datetime(row.get(5)?)?,\n                created_by: row.get(6)?,\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(deps)\n    }\n\n    pub       events.push(Self::row_to_event(row)?);\n        }\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    pub fn list_events_filtered(\n        &self,\n        issue_id: Option<&str>,\n        since: Option<&DateTime<Utc>>,\n        actor: Option<&str>,\n        event_type: Option<&EventType>,\n        limit: Option<usize>,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n        let mut sql = String::from(\n            \"SELECT id, issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, comment, created_at\n             FROM events WHERE 1=1\",\n        );\n        let mut params = Vec::new();\n        let mut param_idx = 1;\n\n        if let Some(id) = issue_id {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND issue_id = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(id.to_string()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(dt) = since {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND created_at >= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(dt.to_rfc3339()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(a) = actor {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND actor = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(a.to_string()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(et) = event_type {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND event_type = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(et.as_str().to_string()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        sql.push_str(\" ORDER BY created_at ASC\");\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" LIMIT {}\", l));\n        }\n\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> = params.iter().map(|p| p.as_ref()).collect();\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(param_refs.as_slice())?;\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            events.push(Self::row_to_event(row)?);\n        }\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    fn row_to_event(row: &rusqlite::Row) -> Result<Event> {\n        let type_str: String = row.get(2)?;\n        Ok(Event {\n            id: row.get(0)?,\n            issue_id: row.get(1)?,\n            event_type: String>> {\n        self.load_annotations(issue_id)\n    }\n\n    pub fn set_annotation(&self, issue_id: &str, key: &str, value: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n      params![issue_id],\n        )?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    pub fn search_issues(\n        &self,\n        query: Option<&str>,\n        status: &[Status],\n        issue_type: &[IssueType],\n        assignee: Option<&str>,\n        labels: &[String],\n        priority_min: Option<i32>,\n        priority_max: Option<i32>,\n        limit: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Issue>> {\n        let mut sql = String::from(\n            \"SELECT DISTINCT i.id, i.content_hash, i.title, i.description, i.design, i.acceptance_criteria, i.notes,\n                    i.status, i.priority, i.issue_type, i.assignee, i.owner, i.estimated_minutes,\n                    i.created_at, i.created_by, i.updated_at, i.closed_at, i.close_reason,\n                    i.closed_by_session, i.due_at, i.defer_until, i.external_ref, i.source_system,\n                    i.source_repo, i.deleted_at, i.deleted_by, i.delete_reason, i.original_type,\n                    i.compaction_level, i.compacted_at, i.compacted_at_commit, i.original_size,\n                    i.sender, i.ephemeral, i.pinned, i.is_template\n             FROM issues i\n             LEFT JOIN labels l ON i.id = l.issue_id\n             WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL\",\n        );\n        let mut params = Vec::new();\n        let mut param_idx = 1;\n        if let Some(q) = query {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\n                \" AND (i.title LIKE ?{} OR i.description LIKE ?{})\",\n                param_idx,\n                param_idx + 1\n            ));\n            params.push(format!(\"%{}%\", q));\n            params.push(format!(\"%{}%\", q));\n            param_idx += 2;\n        }\n        for s in status {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.status = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(s.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        for t in issue_type {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.issue_type = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(t.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(a) = assignee {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.assignee = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(a.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if !labels.is_empty() {\n            let label_conditions: Vec<String> = labels\n                .iter()\n                .enumerate()\n                .map(|(i, _)| format!(\"l.label = ?{}\", param_idx + i))\n                .collect();\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND ({}) \", label_conditions.join(\" OR \")));\n            for label in labels {\n                params.push(label.clone());\n                param_idx += 1;\n            }\n        }\n        if let Some(min) = priority_min {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.priority >= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(min.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(max) = priority_max {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.priority <= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(max.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        sql.push_str(\" ORDER BY i.priority ASC, i.created_at ASC\");\n        if limit > 0 {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" LIMIT {}\", limit));\n        }\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> =\n            params.iter().map(|p| p as &dyn rusqlite::ToSql).collect();\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(param_refs.as_slice())?;\n        let mut issues = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            issues.push(Self::row_to_issue_conn(&conn, row)?);\n        }\n        Ok(issues)\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_stats(&self) -> Result<Stats> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let total: i64 = conn.query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM in_progress: in_progress as usize,\n            closed: closed as usize,\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_stats_by_type(&self) -> Result<Vec<(String, i64)>> {\n        let conn = cross-workspace scoring comparison.\n    ///\n    /// Note: critical_float is the raw float value (lower = more critical).\n    /// The claim scoring uses 1000.0 / (float + 1) as a bonus, which is\n    /// monotonically decreasing with float. Therefore, ordering by float ASC\n    /// is equivalent to ordering by bonus DESC.\n    ///\n    /// When model and harness are provided, uses velocity-aware scoring:\n    /// - LEFT JOINs velocity_stats on (issue_type, model, harness)\n    /// - Returns expected_seconds and combined_score for velocity-adjusted comparison\n    pub fn top_candidate_score(\n        &self,\n        model: Option<&str>,\n        harness: Option<&str>,\n    ) -> Result<Option<crate::claim::Score>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n\n        if let (Some(m), Some(h)) = (model, harness) {\n            // Velocity-aware scoring: join velocity_stats and compute combined_score\n            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n                        i.priority,\n                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts,\n                        vs.p50_seconds as expected_seconds,\n                        (COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) * 3.0\n                         + (4 - i.priority) * 2.0\n                         + 1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1)) as combined_score\n                 FROM issues i\n                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n                 LEFT JOIN velocity_stats vs ON vs.issue_type = i.issue_type\n                     AND vs.model = ?1\n                     AND vs.harness = ?2\n                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n                   AND i.pinned = 0\n                   AND i.is_template = 0\n                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n                       WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n                       AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                       AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n                   )\n                 GROUP BY i.id\n                 ORDER BY\n                     combined_score / COALESCE(vs.p50_seconds, 1800) DESC,\n                     downstream_impact DESC,\n                     critical_float ASC,\n                     i.priority ASC,\n                     i.created_at ASC\n                 LIMIT 1\",\n            )?;\n\n            let mut rows = stmt.query(params![m, h])?;\n            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n                Ok(Some(crate::claim::Score::new(\n                    row.get(0)?,\n                    row.get(1)?,\n                    row.get(2)?,\n                    row.get(3)?,\n                    row.get(4)?,\n                    row.get(5)?,\n                )))\n            } else {\n                Ok(None)\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Standard scoring without velocity data\n            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n                        i.priority,\n                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts\n                 FROM issues i\n                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n                   AND i.pinned = 0\n                   AND i.is_template = 0\n                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n                       WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n                       AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                       AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n                   )\n                 GROUP BY i.id\n                 ORDER BY\n                     downstream_impact DESC,\n                     critical_float ASC,\n                     i.priority ASC,\n                     i.created_at ASC\n                 LIMIT 1\",\n            )?;\n\n            let mut rows = stmt.query([])?;\n            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n                let downstream_impact: i64 = row.get(0)?;\n                let critical_float: i64 = row.get(1)?;\n                let priority: i32 = row.get(2)?;\n                let created_at_ts: i64 = row.get(3)?;\n\n                // Compute combined_score for consistency\n                let combined_score = downstream_impact as f64 * 3.0\n                    + (4 - priority) as f64 * 2.0\n                    + 1000.0 / (critical_float as f64 + 1.0);\n\n                Ok(Some(crate::claim::Score::new(\n                    downstream_impact,\n                    critical_float,\n                    priority,\n                    created_at_ts,\n                    None, // No expected_seconds without velocity data\n                    combined_score,\n                )))\n            } else {\n                Ok(None)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Record a worker session for tracking metadata.\n    ///\n    /// Stores worker metadata (model, harness, version) for each &rusqlite::Error) -> bool {\n    matches!(\n        e,\n        rusqlite::Error::SqliteFailure(\n            rusqlite::ffi::Error {\n                code: rusqlite::ErrorCode::DatabaseBusy,\n                ..\n            },\n            _\n        )\n    )\n}\n\nfn parse_datetime(s: String) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n    let t = s.trim();\n    // bf's own format: RFC3339 (with timezone; optional fractional seconds).\n    match DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(t) {\n        Ok(dt) => Ok(dt.with_timezone(&Utc)),\n        Err(e) => {\n            // br / SQLite-native datetime() format: no timezone, space or 'T'\n            // separator (e.g. \"2026-05-15 21:10:36\"). Assume UTC. !config_path.exists() {\n        let config = format!(\n            r#\"issue_prefixes: [{}]\ndefault_priority: 2\ndefault_type: task\nclaim_ttl_minutes: 30\n\"#,\n            prefix\n        );\n        std::fs::write(&config_path, config)?;\n    }\n\n    let metadata_path = beads_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if !metadata_path.exists() {\n        let metadata = r#\"{\"database\": \"beads.db\", \"jsonl_export\": \"issues.jsonl\"}\"#;\n        std::fs::write(&metadata_path, metadata)?;\n    }\n\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(\"beads.db\");\n    let _storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let gitignore_path = beads_dir.join(\".gitignore\");\n    if !gitignore_path.exists() {\n        std::fs::write(&gitignore_path, \"beads.db\\nbeads.db-shm\\nbeads.db-wal\\n\")?;\n    }\n\n    println!(\"Initialized bead-forge workspace in {:?}\", beads_dir);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_create(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    title: String,\n    type_: String,\n    priority: i32,\n    description: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    labels: Vec<String>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open_with_config(&db_path, &config)?;\n\n    let count = storage.count_issues()?;\n    let prefix = get_default_prefix(&config);\n    let id = crate::id::generate_id(prefix, count);\n\n    let mut issue = Issue::new(id.clone(), title, \".\".to_string());\n    issue.issue_type = IssueType::from_str(type_.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n    issue.priority = Priority(priority);\n    issue.description = description;\n    issue.assignee = assignee;\n    issue.labels = labels;\n\n    storage.create_issue(&issue)?;\n\n    println!(\"{}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_list(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    status: Option<String>,\n    type_: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    annotation: Option<String>,\n    limit: Option<usize>,\n    all: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Parse annotation filter (key=value format)\n    let annotation_filter = match annotation {\n        Some(ref ann) => {\n            let parts: Vec<&str> = ann.splitn(2, '=').collect();\n            if parts.len() != 2 {\n                return Err(anyhow!(\"Invalid annotation format. Use key=value\"));\n            }\n            Some((parts[0].to_string(), parts[1].to_string()))\n        }\n        None => None,\n    };\n\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let mut issues = if all {\n        // Include archived beads\n        list_all_with_archives(beads_dir)?\n    } else {\n        // Only from database\n        let mut filter = IssueFilter::default();\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            filter.status = Some(Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            filter.issue_type =\n                Some(IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        filter.assignee = assignee.clone();\n        filter.priority = priority;\n        filter.annotation = annotation_filter.clone();\n        // --limit 0 means unlimited\n        filter.limit = limit.and_then(|l| if l == 0 { None } else { Some(l) });\n        storage.list_issues(&filter)?\n    };\n\n    // Apply additional filters for --all mode (since we're not using DB filters)\n    if all {\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            let status_filter = Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.status == status_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            let type_filter = IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.issue_type == type_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref assignee_val) = assignee {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.assignee.as_deref() == Some(assignee_val));\n        }\n        if let Some(p) = priority {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.priority.0 == p);\n        }\n        if let Some((ref key, ref value)) = annotation_filter {\n            issues.retain(|i| {\n                i.annotations\n                    .get(key)\n                    .map_or(false, |v| v == value)\n            });\n        }\n        // Apply limit\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            if l != 0 {\n                issues.truncate(l);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let output_format = OutputFormat::from_str(format).unwrap_or(OutputFormat::Text);\n    let formatter = get_formatter(output_format);\n    print!(\"{}\", formatter.format_issues(&issues));\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_show(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let issue = match storage.get_issue(id)? {\n        Some(i) => i,\n        None => {\n            // Search archives\n            find_bead_in_archives(beads_dir, id)?\n                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id))?\n        }\n    };\n\n    match format {\n        \"json\" => {\n            // Strip dependencies/comments before serializing: NEEDLE's BrDependency\n            // format ({id, title, status, priority, dependency_type}) differs from\n            // bead-forge's Dependency format ({issue_id, depends_on_id, type, ...}).\n            // NEEDLE has #[serde(default)] on the deps field so empty is fine.\n            let mut out = issue;\n            out.dependencies = vec![];\n            out.comments = vec![];\n            // Wrap in array so NEEDLE's parse_single_bead (Vec<Bead> → first) works.\n            println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&vec![out])?);\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_update(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    id: &str,\n    title: Option<String>,\n    status: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    description: Option<String>,\n    acceptance_criteria: Option<String>,\n    notes: Option<String>,\n    design: Option<String>,\n    due_at: Option<String>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open_with_config(&db_path, &config)?;\n\n    // Parse due_at if provided\n    let due_at_parsed = match due_at {\n        Some(date_str) => {\n            let dt = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&date_str)\n                .map_err(|_| anyhow!(\"Invalid --due-at format. Use RFC3339 format, e.g., 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z\"))?;\n            Some(dt.with_timezone(&Utc))\n        }\n        None => None,\n    };\n\n    let changes = IssueChanges {\n        title,\n        status: status.map(|s| Status::from_str(&s).ok()).flatten(),\n        priority,\n        assignee,\n        description,\n        acceptance_criteria,\n        notes,\n        design,\n        due_at: due_at_parsed,\n        ..Default::default()\n    };\n\n    storage.update_issue(id, &changes)?;\n    println!(\"Updated bead {}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_close(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, reason: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    storage.close_issue(id, reason, \"cli\")?;\n    println!(\"Closed bead {}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_reopen(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let changes = IssueChanges {\n        status: Some(Status::Open),\n        ..Default::default()\n    };\n\n    storage.update_issue(id, &changes)?;\n    println!(\"Reopened bead {}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_delete(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n        tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM issues WHERE id = ?\", [&id])?;\n        Ok(())\n    })?;\n\n    println!(\"Deleted bead {}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_ready(beads_dir: &PathBuf, limit: usize, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    // --limit 0 means unlimited (get_ready_candidates omits LIMIT clause when limit == 0)\n    let candidates = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, limit, None, None))?;\n\n    match format {\n        \"json\" => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&candidate)?);\n            }\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\n                    \"{}\",\n                    crate::format::toon::format_ready_bead(\n                        &candidate.id,\n                        &candidate.title,\n                        candidate.priority,\n    workspace_paths: &[PathBuf],\n    dry_run: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let claim_ttl = config.claim_ttl_minutes;\n\n    // Build              println!(\"No beads available to claim\");\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_sync(beads_dir: &PathBuf, flush_only: bool, import_only: bool) -> result.missing_in_jsonl.len()\n                + result.missing_in_sqlite.len()\n                + result.hash_mismatch.len();\n\n            if total_drift == 0 {\n                println!(\"✓                  }\n                    if result.missing_in_jsonl.len() > 10 {\n                        println!(\"    ... and {} more\", result.missing_in_jsonl.len() - 10);\n                    }\n                }\n                if !result.missing_in_sqlite.is_empty() {\n                    println!(\"  Missing in SQLite ({}):\", result.missing_in_sqlite.len());\n                    for id in      println!(\"    ... and {} more\", result.missing_in_sqlite.len() - 10);\n                    }\n                }\n                if !result.hash_mismatch.is_empty() {\n         }\n                    if result.hash_mismatch.len() > 10 {\n                        println!(\"    ... and {} more\", result.hash_mismatch.len() - 10);\n                    }\n    };\n\n    println!(\"{}\", count);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_batch(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    file: Option<PathBuf>,\n    json: Option<String>,\n    stdin: bool,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let       eprintln!(\n                \"[op {}] error: {}\",\n                result.op,\n                result.error.unwrap_or_default()\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_mitosis(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    id: &str,\n    children: &str,\n    reason: &str,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata =        println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&results)?);\n        }\n        _ => {\n            // Print child IDs that were created\n            for result in &results {\n                if print_dep_tree(nodes: &[crate::storage::DepTreeNode], _storage: &Storage) -> Result<()> {\n    if nodes.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"  (no dependencies)\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Status indicators: ●=open, ◐=in_progress, ○=closed/blocked/deferred, ⊘=tombstone\n    let status_symbol = |status: &str| -> char {\n        match status {\n            \"open\" => '●',\n            \"in_progress\" => '◐',\n            \"closed\" => '○',\n            \"blocked\" => '◌',\n            \"deferred\" => '○',\n            \"tombstone\" => '⊘',\n            _ => '○',\n        }\n    };\n\n    for (i, node) in nodes.iter().enumerate() {\n        let is_cycle = node.path.contains(\"[CYCLE]\");\n\n        // Build tree prefix with proper branching\n        let mut prefix = String::new();\n        if node.depth > 0 {\n            for d in 0..node.depth as usize {\n                if d < node.depth as usize - 1 {\n                    prefix.push_str(\"│   \");\n                } else {\n                    // Check if this is the last node at this depth\n                    let is_last = nodes\n                        .iter()\n                        .skip(i + 1)\n                        .all(|n| n.depth < node.depth || (n.depth == node.depth && n.id > node.id));\n                    if is_last {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"└── \");\n                    } else {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"├── \");\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Truncate title if too long\n        let title = if node.title.len() > 60 {\n            format!(\"{}...\", &node.title[..57])\n        } else {\n            node.title.clone()\n        };\n\n        let cycle_mark = if is_cycle { \" [CYCLE]\" } else { \"\" };\n        let dep_type_str = node.dep_type.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"blocks\");\n\n        println!(\n            \"{}[{}] {} {} (P{}, {}){}\",\n            prefix,\n            node.id,\n            status_symbol(&node.status),\n            title,\n            node.priority,\n            dep_type_str,\n            cycle_mark\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_dep(beads_dir: &PathBuf, dep: DepCommands) -> Result<()> {\n    match dep {\n        DepCommands::Add {\n            issue,\n            depends_on,\n            type_,\n        } => {\n            let metadata = &depends_on)?;\n            println!(\"Removed dependency: {} -> {}\", issue, depends_on);\n        }\n        DepCommands::List { id } => {\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n ({})\",\n                        dep.issue_id, dep.depends_on_id, dep.dep_type\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        DepCommands::Tree {\n            id,\n            direction,\n            max_depth,\n            format,\n            json,\n        } => {\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = direction\n            let direction = match direction.as_str() {\n                \"down\" | \"up\" | \"both\" => direction.as_str(),\n                _ => {\n                    return Err(anyhow!(\n                        \"Invalid direction: {}. Use 'down', 'up', or 'both'\",\n                        direction\n                    ))\n                }\n            };\n\n            if format == \"json\" {\n                // JSON output format\n                if direction == \"both\" {\n                    let down_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"down\", max_depth)?;\n                    let up_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"up\", max_depth)?;\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"root_id\": id,\n                        \"direction\": direction,\n                        \"max_depth\": max_depth,\n                        \"downward\": down_nodes,\n                        \"upward\": up_nodes\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&output)?);\n                } else {\n                    let nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, direction, max_depth)?;\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"root_id\": id,\n                        \"direction\": direction,\n                        \"max_depth\": max_depth,\n                        \"nodes\": nodes\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&output)?);\n                }\n            } else {\n                // Text output format\n                if direction == \"both\" {\n                    // Show both directions separately\n                    println!(\n                        \"Dependency tree for {} (downward - what this depends on):\\n\",\n                        id\n                    );\n                    let down_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"down\", max_depth)?;\n                    print_dep_tree(&down_nodes, &storage)?;\n\n                    if !down_nodes.is_empty() {\n                        println!();\n                    }\n\n                    println!(\n                        \"Reverse dependency tree for {} (upward - what depends on this):\\n\",\n                        id\n                    );\n                    let up_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"up\", max_depth)?;\n                    print_dep_tree(&up_nodes, &storage)?;\n                } else {\n                    let nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, direction, max_depth)?;\n                    print_dep_tree(&nodes, &storage)?;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_label(beads_dir: &PathBuf, label: LabelCommands) -> Result<()> {\n    match label {\n
